answer: A farm bets the verifier will never ask a second witness. Time-locked vault deposit with escalating release schedule asks one: a deposit that unlocks in stages over eighteen months. The nebula of the check is the second voice — someone with no stake in this epoch who confirms the same fact from their own files. One fake witness is a phone call; a hundred means a hundred people who must all lie on cue. The ledge of the hundred is the coordination bill: one honest answer and the chain snaps. The terrace that closes the test is the third call, made to an office the applicant never named.
